name: Confession Bear
look: A close-up photo of a black sun bear with a pale tan muzzle resting its chin and long curved claws on a weathered log, looking at the camera with a sad, guilty pout against a blurred background.
use: The bear makes an embarrassing, guilty or unpopular confession. The caption admits a secret the poster would never say out loud, split across the top and bottom of the image.
slots: top caption: the start of the confession
examples: I text 'on my way' while I'm still in bed
and I've never once been on my way
I've never seen the movie everyone quotes

guilty looking black bear with long claws
